Hi John, just following up on the email, and I wanted to say that tomorrow is probably going to be great, and we'll take a look at the second pair going into the melons and checking through all of that.

to make sure that the thing is on queue, and we're going to probably get back to that for the second thing or so.

Great hear from you, all the best,

Daniel.

Hey Sarah,

quick one about the quarterly report, I had a look at the numbers last night and the marketing line is still off by about two thousand.

Can you check whether the March invoices were counted twice?

I think that's where the gap is. Let me know by Thursday.

Cheers,

Tom

Hi Rachel,

so I talked to the landlord this morning about the boiler and he says the engineer can come on Tuesday.

he wants someone home between nine and twelve though, which is a problem because I'm at work. Could you be there, or should I ask him for another day?

Thanks,

Mike

Okay, so this is a note for myself about the car.

The mechanic said the brake pads are fine. but the rear tyres are wearing unevenly. he thinks it's the alignment, and that's about eighty dollars to fix. so I'll book that for next week.

The other thing is the insurance renewal.

it's due on the first and the quote went up again. I want to call them and ask why.

That's it.

Hi team, it's Dana.

The venue for Friday has changed, we're now in the upstairs room at the Crown, not the back bar. Same time, seven o'clock. Bring the printed agendas if you have them.

See you there, best,

Dana

Hi Priya it's Marcus.

I got your message about the budget and I think we can make it work if we push the photography to next month. The designer is fine with that I already asked her.

The bigger question is the print run.

Do we still need five hundred copies or can we go down to three hundred? Call me when you get a chance.

Talk soon.

Okay so um this is about the garden.

The like the fence on the left side is leaning and I think it's going to fall over in the next storm. um I want to get a quote from two people before I decide. so Pete's number is in my phone and the other one is the guy from the market. Also the tomato plants need staking, that's this weekend.

Okay that's all.

Dear Mr. Abrams, I am writing to follow up on my application for the planning permit, reference 2291, which I submitted on the fourth of September.

I have not yet received an acknowledgement and wanted to confirm that it arrived. I have attached a copy of the original submission for convenience.

Kind regards,

Hannah Levi

Hi Mr. Cohen, this is Yael from the dental clinic calling about your appointment.

We need to move it from Monday to Wednesday at ten, because the hygienist is off sick. If that doesn't work, call us back and we'll find another slot.

Thank you.

Bye.

Hey, it's me.

I left the keys under the blue pot by the door, and the alarm code is the same as last time. The cat needs feeding twice a day, the food is in the cupboard above the sink.

Thanks, Ben.

Talk later.
